name: stale_st_within_count
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM parcel_address_points pap JOIN parcels p ON p.id = pap.parcel_id JOIN address_points ap ON ap.address_point_id = pap.address_point_id WHERE NOT ST_Within(ap.geom, p.geom)

name: missed_link_count
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM address_points ap WHERE ap.geom IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM parcels p WHERE p.geom IS NOT NULL AND ST_Within(ap.geom, p.geom) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM parcel_address_points pap WHERE pap.parcel_id = p.id AND pap.address_point_id = ap.address_point_id))

name: multi_parcel_address_count
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM (SELECT address_point_id FROM parcel_address_points GROUP BY address_point_id HAVING count(*) > 1) d

name: dup_count
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM (SELECT parcel_id, address_point_id FROM parcel_address_points GROUP BY parcel_id, address_point_id HAVING count(*) > 1) d

name: fanout_max_condo
sql: SELECT COALESCE(max(cnt), 0)::int FROM (SELECT pap.parcel_id, count(*) AS cnt FROM parcel_address_points pap JOIN parcels p ON p.id = pap.parcel_id WHERE p.feature_type = 'CONDO' GROUP BY pap.parcel_id) s

name: fanout_max_noncondo
sql: SELECT COALESCE(max(cnt), 0)::int FROM (SELECT pap.parcel_id, count(*) AS cnt FROM parcel_address_points pap JOIN parcels p ON p.id = pap.parcel_id WHERE p.feature_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'CONDO' GROUP BY pap.parcel_id) s

name: noncondo_gt_20_count
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM (SELECT pap.parcel_id, count(*) AS cnt FROM parcel_address_points pap JOIN parcels p ON p.id = pap.parcel_id WHERE p.feature_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'CONDO' GROUP BY pap.parcel_id HAVING count(*) > 20) s

name: land_entrance_count
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM parcel_address_points pap JOIN address_points ap ON ap.address_point_id = pap.address_point_id WHERE ap.address_class_desc = 'Land Entrance'

name: structure_class_link_rate_pct
sql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM parcel_address_points pap WHERE pap.address_point_id = ap.address_point_id)) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 2)::float FROM address_points ap WHERE ap.geom IS NOT NULL AND ap.address_class_desc = 'Structure'

name: rd_rs_fanout_gt_15_count
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM (SELECT pap.parcel_id, count(*) AS cnt FROM parcel_address_points pap JOIN parcels p ON p.id = pap.parcel_id WHERE p.zoning_class IN ('RD', 'RS') GROUP BY pap.parcel_id HAVING count(*) > 15) s
